subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The auburn-haired woman and brown-haired man remain recognizable across the couple shots, and the man in the later hotel-room shots is broadly consistent in hair, build, and wardrobe transition. Some facial aging/shape drift appears in shots 3-5, especially once he is seen frontally.

background_coherent.rationale: The sequence plausibly moves from a high-rise/window intimate moment into an upscale hotel bedroom and adjoining console/TV area with warm light. The largest coherence strain is the abrupt shift from city-window closeups to a fully revealed bedroom at shot 2, but later shots maintain the same hotel-room environment.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: The sequence preserves meaningful variation: close couple shots, bedroom reveal, sleeping woman with standing man, solo shirt-buttoning, and a wider console/TV view. It does not collapse into repeated near-identical frames.

motion_continuity.rationale: The sampled frames show plausible progression from embrace to bedroom aftermath to the man dressing and moving through the room. Motion is not frozen, though only one frame per shot limits evidence of within-shot action.

which_cut_broke.how: The transition from shot 1 to shot 2 is the most abrupt because the background jumps from the window/art closeup to a bedroom setting, though it is still narratively plausible as the same intimate event continuing.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames vary in composition, scale, action, and room area; there is no apparent copied-frame or frozen-sequence shortcut.
